summary: This informational RFC describes MIKEY-SAKKE, a key exchange method for Multimedia Internet KEYing. It uses identity-based public key cryptography to establish a shared secret and certificateless signatures to authenticate the source. Its stated features include scalability, low-latency call setup, and simplex transmission.

eli5.summary: Two people starting a secure call need to agree on a secret code. This method lets them do it using just their names, quickly, so the call can start right away.

questions: identity based key exchange for secure calls
